faqs.q: Who must take GST registration?
faqs.a: Registration is mandatory once aggregate turnover crosses the prescribed threshold, and in some cases irrespective of turnover, such as certain interstate supplies and e-commerce operators. Thresholds are revised from time to time, so we confirm the current limit for your case before applying.

faqs.q: Can I get GST registration without a shop or office?
faqs.a: Yes, in many cases a home address can be the principal place of business with valid address proof and consent from the owner. The proof requirements depend on whether the premises is owned, rented or shared.

faqs.q: How long does GST registration take?
faqs.a: When documents are complete, the application is generally processed within a few working days. Queries or a physical verification can extend this.

faqs.q: Should I choose composition scheme or regular registration?
faqs.a: Composition has lower compliance but restricts input tax credit and interstate supply. We compare both against your margins, customers and expansion plans before you choose.

faqs.q: What is the difference between GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B?
faqs.a: GSTR-1 reports your outward supplies invoice-wise, while GSTR-3B is the summary return in which you declare liability, claim input tax credit and pay tax.

faqs.q: What happens if I miss a GST return due date?
faqs.a: A late fee applies per day of delay, along with interest on any unpaid tax. Continued non-filing can lead to notices and cancellation of registration, so file delayed returns quickly.

faqs.q: Do I have to file GST returns if I had no sales?
faqs.a: Yes. A nil return is still required for each period unless you are covered by a specific exemption or have cancelled your registration.

faqs.q: Can I claim input tax credit on every purchase?
faqs.a: No. Credit is available only if the supplier has reported the invoice, you hold a valid document, and the purchase is not blocked under the GST law. We check this against GSTR-2B every month.

faqs.q: How often is director KYC required?
faqs.a: Annually, by the date prescribed under the rules, which is generally 30 September for the preceding financial year.

faqs.q: What happens if I miss the DIR-3 KYC?
faqs.a: The DIN is marked deactivated and a fee is payable to reactivate it. The director cannot sign filings meanwhile.

faqs.q: Is DIR-3 KYC required for LLP partners too?
faqs.a: Yes, designated partners and other partners holding a DIN must complete KYC.

faqs.q: Can you do KYC for several directors at once?
faqs.a: Yes. We handle multiple directors and keep a tracker for your company.

intro: Udyam registration gives your business formal MSME recognition, which can help with bank credit, government schemes and delayed-payment protection. We complete it correctly the first time and keep details updated.

faqs.q: Is Udyam registration free?
faqs.a: The government portal does not charge a fee for Udyam registration. Professional charges, if any, are for our assistance.

faqs.q: What benefits does Udyam give?
faqs.a: Benefits can include priority sector lending, collateral-free credit schemes, and some tax and subsidy benefits.

faqs.q: Do I need GST to register under Udyam?
faqs.a: GST is not always required, but it must be linked where the business is already registered.

faqs.q: Do I need to renew it every year?
faqs.a: There is no renewal, but you must update turnover and investment details as the portal requires.
